title: Price Reversion Frequency
scenario: Find products that returned to a price they had previously held, after changing to at least two other distinct prices in between.
tableSchema: products (product_id INT, new_price INT, change_date DATE)
hint: Join the table with itself on product_id and price, then count distinct intermediate prices.
correctQuery: SELECT DISTINCT p1.product_id FROM products p1 JOIN products p2 ON p1.product_id = p2.product_id AND p1.new_price = p2.new_price WHERE p2.change_date > p1.change_date AND (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT new_price) FROM products p3 WHERE p3.product_id = p1.product_id AND p3.change_date > p1.change_date AND p3.change_date < p2.change_date) >= 2;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE products (product_id INT, new_price INT, change_date DATE);
